# Each line is a one-paragraph statement. + finds nothing of the rule; - finds exactly what the brackets hold.
- The interface shall be ⟦user-friendly⟧.
- The system shall respond ⟦fast⟧ to a request.
- The report shall load ⟦quickly⟧.
- The pump shall run for ⟦about⟧ 5 minutes.
- The system shall use an ⟦appropriate⟧ cipher.
- The cache shall be ⟦large⟧ enough for the data.
- The service shall restart ⟦as soon as possible⟧ after a crash.
- The design shall follow ⟦state of the art⟧ methods.
+ The system shall respond within 200 ms.
# About is vague only before a number.
+ The manual shall hold a chapter about safety.
+ The breakfast shall be served at 7:00.
+ The editor shall highlight the selected row.
+ The pump shall run for at most 5 minutes.
